newspaper.headline: New Contributors Popping Up in the Repository
newspaper.lead: Many new accounts sent pull requests to Nusa Digital's repository this week. The security team reminds developers to read every change carefully.

impact.good: Yesterday, all new logic was released with edge-case tests. No new bugs in the apps.
impact.mixed: Yesterday, some PRs had good tests, but a few slipped through without edge-case tests. Dimas asked for a recheck.
impact.bad: Yesterday, some PRs without tests were released and old bugs came back. Users complained.

tip.title: Tip: Know the Author
tip.text: Before approving a PR, check who wrote it and where the code sends data. Unknown account + unknown address = escalate.

newspaper.classified: WANTED: The owner of the 'helper-kode' account that keeps sending PRs at midnight. — K.

boss.title: The Mysterious PR
boss.intro: A suspicious trail in the logs, a robot in a maze and a mysterious PR all arrive together. This is your final test!
